test_blade_dancer_description: Assassinate a troop. Focus - Gain 3 Power.
core_noble_description: Promote a card from your hand.
wight_description: Choose one: Gain 2 Power. Or, devour a card in your hand to Supplant a troop.
market_corruptor_description: You may devour a card from the Market to gain 3 Influence.
carrion_crawler_description: Gain 3 Power. Devour a card in the market and replace it with this card.
skeletal_horde_description: Deploy 2 troops. Optional: Devour this card -> Deploy 3 additional troops.
cultist_of_myrkul_description: Choose one: Gain 2 Influence. Or, devour this card; at end of turn, promote up to 2 other cards played this turn.
cloaker_description: Choose one: Place a spy. Or, return one of your spies to assassinate a troop at that spy's site.
neogi_description: Deploy 4 troops. At end of turn, each opponent must discard a card.
ulitharid_description: Play a card in the market that costs 4 or less as if it was in your hand, then devour that card.
insane_outcast_description: Discard a card from your hand to return Insane Outcast to the supply. If Insane Outcast would be devoured or promoted, return it to the supply instead.
cranium_rats_description: Deploy 2 troops. Choose one opponent with more than 3 cards to discard a card.
banshee_description: Place a spy. If another player's spy is at that site, gain 3 Power.
infiltrator_description: Place a spy. If another player's troop is at that site, gain 1 Power.
matron_mother_description: Put your deck into your discard pile. Then promote a card from your discard pile.
necromancer_description: Choose one: gain 3 Power, or promote this card or a card from your hand or discard pile.
black_wyrmling_description: Gain 1 Power. Assassinate a white troop.
crushing_wave_cultist_description: Assassinate a white troop. Focus - Deploy 2 troops.
kobold_description: Choose one: Deploy a troop. Or, assassinate a white troop.
master_of_melee_magthere_description: Choose one: Deploy 4 troops. Or, Supplant a white troop anywhere on the board.
ogre_zombie_description: Supplant a white troop anywhere on the board.
olhydra_description: Supplant a white troop anywhere on the board. Focus - Deploy 2 troops.
